articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
articles.snippet: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.snippet: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.
